facts.fact: Gabonactu reports that on 11 February 2026 a World Bank delegation found the eGabon-SIS system working in 13 pilot hospitals across Grand Libreville, the Egypt-Gabon cooperation hospital among them and described as fully computerised with the patient record available; the Libreville university hospital and the regional hospitals were not yet covered.
The system ran in 13 pilot hospitals in Grand Libreville on 11 February 2026, per Gabonactu; the document names no primary clinic using it and gives no denominator.

On 11 February 2026 the director general of the Egypt-Gabon cooperation hospital said one year of use as a pilot site had cut patient waiting time, centralised finances and made the patient record available; the health minister asked the World Bank, which agreed, to bring the system into the Libreville university hospital, and said it would extend to every regional hospital.
Gabonactu states on 11 February 2026 that the eGabon-SIS project is financed by the World Bank; no domestic budget line is mentioned.

systems.owner: not stated; Ministry of Health with World Bank financing
systems.tiers: 13 pilot hospitals in Grand Libreville; extension to the CHUL and all regional hospitals (CHR) announced

note: Classed emr because the document says the system makes the patient record available, alongside patient flow and finances. The tier value T2 is a reading: the document calls all 13 sites hospitals and says the university hospital and the regional hospitals are still to come, but does not state their tier; the earlier documents in this list count health centres among the pilot sites. It does not say where the record is keyed.
